name: Brightest Bulb in the Darkest Room
summary:
A short and surreal horror game made in RPG Maker 2003 for the 2026 SCREAMOLOGY game jam. The gameplay takes some inspiration from Yume Nikki, GOHOME, and the original Slender.

Follow Conny as they attempt to escape their new surreal surroundings. Conduct rituals at bookcases with scrapped notes to try and find a way out. Try to outrun the horrors in the dark as you navigate the strange landscape.
